observations.observation: Read all3356 characters. The opening sets decomposition, interaction and diversity objectives; the next paragraph cleans34 literature samples, checks them against supplied conclusions, clusters by two traits and compares four decomposition candidates before selecting a regression-based model. The growth/competition paragraph shares an environmental-impact factor and gives multi/single ratios under optimal conditions with equal initial proportions. The fluctuation paragraph states periodic forcing, distinguishes short susceptibility from long stability and reports a reversal: under fluctuation population ratio remains above1 but decomposition ratio is0.93. Preserve this as a counterexample to an unqualified claim that diversity always increases decomposition efficiency, and keep optimal versus variable conditions separate. Climate comparisons and survival lead to the final diversity/stability framing and college-student article. The claimed model selection is described without a comparison score here, and stability/conclusions are author statements rather than verified results. Source defects matter: 'we' at the end of one block continues with 'obtain' in another, several word wraps are retained, and form/promotion material is selected. The incomplete paragraph structure requires source inspection rather than treating the split as intentional rhetorical rhythm. No formula or figure interpretation.
